data.one_liner: A Dart library for HTTP requests inspired by python-requests with cookie storage.
data.what_it_does: Allows making HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE, etc.) with automatic cookie handling, custom body encoding, response parsing, and error checking.
use_when: You want an API similar to Python's requests module in Dart
You need automatic storage and re-sending of server-side cookies
You want simple methods to inspect response status and decode JSON bodies
avoid_when: You require advanced enterprise HTTP features like interceptors or global configuration
You are already using a more robust client like Dio for complex networking
strengths: Simple and intuitive API inspired by Python requests
weaknesses: Less feature-rich compared to mature networking packages like Dio
Limited customization for complex enterprise HTTP flows

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard, lightweight package maintained by the Dart team for basic HTTP requests.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Powerful HTTP client supporting interceptors, global configuration, FormData, and request cancellation.
